items.rule: Judge every result, finding and side effect by the purpose (what the owner or users get, as a number if one exists; check on real inputs; an accepted side effect needs a written reason, and 'succeeds' must mean usable) and whether the critical path or its bottleneck moves; off-path work waits or is tracked. PRs, ledgers, review rounds and rules are means.
items.why: Whether work serves the purpose is judgment no hook can read: two orchestrators admitted spending most effort on means off the critical path, and one accepted a side effect that defeated the purpose.

items.rule: Choose methods yourself after consulting the reviewers assigned in review.md (Codex and agy in parallel for design or planning choices) and report the choice; ask the owner only for owner-only, scope, public-behaviour or irreversible decisions, with a comparison and a recommendation. Order work by priority; take unblockers first, and small owner-completable items only while the critical path waits.
items.why: The owner was over-asked about method choices and had to gather evidence again.
items.source: hiden SKILL.md 進め方 4; 範囲 (order)

items.rule: Back each claim with the strongest available evidence: check the path actually ran, on the real thing as soon as it exists, and name the one fact the safety rests on.
items.why: Plausible but unverified claims pass review; no tool can tell which fact a claim rests on.
